prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) coconut palm; 2) small palm; 3) pink coral cluster; 4) ship anchor leaning; 5) stack of floats and buoys; 6) fishing net drying on a frame; 7) white clay flower pot with bougainvillea; 8) blue-painted wooden bench; 9) seashell pile; 10) barrel of fish; 11) rope bollard; 12) small stone lighthouse lamp pillar (unlit); 13) driftwood log; 14) beach umbrella of palm leaves; 15) treasure map signboard (blank).
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 15 distinct, separate props in a 3-column x 5-row grid, reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each object entirely within its cell, generous empty transparent margins between objects; no overlap or clipping. Classical three-quarter top-down JRPG object view: visible top surfaces and front faces, standing upright with base toward bottom. Row 1: (1) tall coconut palm with coconuts, (2) shorter small palm, (3) pink coral cluster. Row 2: (4) leaning ship anchor, (5) stacked floats and buoys, (6) fishing net drying on a wooden frame. Row 3: (7) white clay flower pot with magenta bougainvillea, (8) blue-painted wooden bench, (9) pile of seashells. Row 4: (10) open barrel full of fish, (11) rope-wrapped bollard, (12) small unlit stone lighthouse lamp pillar. Row 5: (13) driftwood log, (14) palm-leaf beach umbrella, (15) blank treasure-map signboard with no writing. Props should be visually identifiable and consistent in scale, trees roughly three times the height of smallest props. Premium modern high-bit 2D pixel art JRPG videogame assets, deliberate handmade clusters of clear hard-edged SQUARE pixels, uniform pixel scale across the ENTIRE sheet, crisp nearest-neighbor edges, no antialias, no blur, no soft brush, no noise or checkerboard dithering. 4-6 shades per material with earthy rich color and hue-shifted purple/red saturated shadows, warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination, clean base colors. ABSOLUTELY NO cast shadows, NO ground, NO lighting pools, NO glowing lights, NO vignette. Fully transparent alpha background, not white or checkerboard. No labels, text, or numerals.
